core.module.name: Core
core.module.description: The platform itself: settings, modules, background work and the audit log. Always on.
core.settings.site.name.label: The theatre's name
core.settings.site.name.help: Shown in the site's header, on emails and in page titles. Set during setup.
core.settings.site.origin.label: The site's address
core.settings.site.origin.help: The one address people use, such as https://tickets.example.org. Links in emails are built from it, and any other address redirects here. Recorded during setup; change it only when the site moves.
core.settings.locale.time-zone.label: Time zone
core.settings.locale.time-zone.help: Where the theatre is. Dates, times and scheduled work follow this zone, including the clock changes. Set during setup; until then scheduled work runs on UTC.
core.settings.locale.currency.label: Currency
core.settings.locale.language.label: Language
core.settings.locale.language.help: The language the site is written in.
core.settings.locale.day-start.label: When the theatre's day starts
core.settings.locale.day-start.help: Anything before this time counts as the previous day, so a late show's sales and takings stay with the evening they belong to.
core.settings.units.statement-limit.labe: Most database statements in one change
core.settings.units.statement-limit.help: A change that would need more is refused before anything is written. Raise it only if a screen says it was refused for this reason.
core.settings.units.set-rows-limit.label: Most rows written together in one change
core.settings.units.set-rows-limit.help: When one change writes many similar rows at once, such as a message to everyone booked for a performance, they are written together up to this number. A change that would write more in one go is refused before anything is written.
core.settings.jobs.attempts.label: Attempts before background work gives up
core.settings.jobs.attempts.help: How many times a background job is tried before it is shown on the health screen as failed.
core.settings.jobs.backoff.label: First wait before trying again
core.settings.jobs.backoff.help: How long a failed background job waits before its second attempt. Each later wait is twice as long.
core.settings.jobs.timeout.label: Longest a background job may run
core.settings.jobs.timeout.help: A job still running after this long is treated as stopped and tried again.
core.settings.jobs.keep-for.label: Keep finished background work for
core.settings.jobs.keep-for.help: How long the record of finished jobs and scheduled runs is kept.
core.settings.external.timeout.label: Wait for an outside service
core.settings.external.timeout.help: How long to wait for a payment provider or another outside service before treating the answer as unknown.
core.settings.external.reconcile-after.h: When an outside service did not answer, how long to wait before asking it what happened.
core.settings.access.fresh-within.label: Confirm it is you every
core.settings.access.fresh-within.help: For sensitive actions, how recently a person must have confirmed their sign-in.
core.settings.idempotency.keep-for.label: Remember repeated requests for
core.settings.idempotency.keep-for.help: How long a request that may be repeated, such as a payment, is remembered so it is not carried out twice.
core.settings.rate-limits.default.label: Rate limit: reading
core.settings.rate-limits.default.help: How many ordinary requests one person or network address may make in a period.
core.settings.rate-limits.write.label: Rate limit: changes
core.settings.rate-limits.write.help: How many changes one person may make in a period.
core.settings.rate-limits.sign-in.label: Rate limit: signing in
core.settings.rate-limits.sign-in.help: How many attempts one person, email address or network address may make in a period at the other identity steps: recovery codes, confirming it is you, adding an address and first-run setup. Counted across every copy of the site.
core.settings.rate-limits.sign-in-networ: Rate limit: signing in from one network
How many sign-in requests one network address may make in a period. Keep it high: everyone on a students' union or halls network shares one address. Counted across every copy of the site.
core.settings.rate-limits.sign-in-link.h: How many sign-in emails one email address may ask for in a period. Over it, no email is sent and the page looks the same. Counted across every copy of the site.
core.settings.rate-limits.sign-in-code.h: How many sign-in codes may be tried for one email address in a period. Counted across every copy of the site.
core.settings.rate-limits.public-form.he: How many public form submissions one network address may make in a period. Counted across every copy of the site.
core.settings.rate-limits.export.label: Rate limit: exports
core.settings.rate-limits.export.help: How many exports one person may start in a period.
core.settings.rate-limits.presented-valu: Rate limit: typed numbers and codes
How many times one session or network address may try a membership number or other code it typed, in a period. Counted across every copy of the site.
An account made for someone who has never signed in, booked or been given a role since is anonymised once this long has passed.
core.settings.retention.dormant-after.he: An account nobody has signed in to for this long is anonymised, after the person has been warned by email.
core.settings.retention.run-cap.label: Most accounts erased in one run
core.settings.retention.run-cap.help: A sweep stops after this many, so a mistaken setting cannot erase many people at once.
core.settings.retention.armed.label: Let the account sweeps erase
core.settings.retention.armed.help: While this is off, the sweeps only report what they would do. Only an Owner can turn it on, and must say why.
core.settings.retention.audit.label: Keep the audit log for
core.settings.retention.audit.help: How long the record of who did what is kept. Names in older entries are removed after this.
Keep the history of setting changes for
How long the history of who changed each setting, and why, is kept.
core.settings.rules.site-origin-shape: Give the address as https:// and the host only, such as https://tickets.example.org, with no path.
core.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change the platform's settings
core.abilities.modules.manage.label: Switch modules on and off
core.abilities.job.manage.label: Cancel background work that has not started
core.abilities.health.view.label: See the Health screen
core.abilities.signing-key.retire.label: Retire a signing key at once
core.settings.sign-in.email-link.label: Sign in by emailed link and code
core.settings.sign-in.email-link.help: Whether people can be sent a link and a code to sign in. Passkeys are always available.
core.settings.sign-in.link-lifetime.help: How long a sign-in link and its code work after they are sent.
core.settings.sign-in.unverified-address: How long an address someone adds may wait for its confirmation link to be used before it is removed.
core.settings.sign-in.address-resend-aft: Wait before sending a confirmation link again
How long someone must wait after a confirmation link is sent to an address they added before they can ask for it again.
core.settings.recovery.enrolment-link-li: How long a link a member of staff issues for adding a passkey works.
core.settings.sign-in.invite-lifetime.he: How long the link in an invitation works. After that, the person can still sign in with the same address and finds their role waiting.
core.settings.emergency-contacts.keep-af: Keep emergency contacts after membership ends for
How long a person's emergency contacts are kept after their last standing ends, so a gap between two memberships loses nothing.
core.settings.sign-in.code-attempts.help: How many wrong codes may be typed before the person has to ask for a new email.
core.settings.sign-in.open-sign-up.label: Anyone can create an account
core.settings.sign-in.open-sign-up.help: When this is off, only people who already have an account can sign in. Buying tickets as a guest still works.
core.settings.sign-in.google.label: Sign in with Google
core.settings.sign-in.google.help: Offer a “Sign in with Google” button. Needs the Google client id below and the Google client secret under Keys, at the foot of this page.
core.settings.sign-in.google-client-id.h: The client id from your Google Cloud project's OAuth credentials. It ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com.
core.settings.sign-in.google-domains.hel: Only Google accounts from these organisation domains may sign in. Leave empty to accept any Google account.
core.settings.sign-in.managed-domains.he: Email domains whose addresses sign in only through Google and are never sent a sign-in link.
core.settings.sign-in.provider-is-strong: Treat Google sign-in from these domains as strong
core.settings.sign-in.authenticator.labe: Offer an authenticator app to staff
core.settings.sign-in.authenticator.help: People whose roles reach the console can add an app such as Google Authenticator or 1Password, and use its codes to confirm it is them when their passkey is not to hand. It never signs anyone in on its own.
core.settings.sign-in.authenticator-is-s: Accept an email sign-in plus an authenticator code for the console
With this on, signing in by email or Google and then typing a code from the app counts like a passkey, so staff can use the console on a shared laptop. Turn it off to require a passkey.
core.settings.sign-in.provider-is-strong: Turn on only if your Google organisation makes everyone use two-step sign-in. Then a Google sign-in counts like a passkey.
core.settings.sign-in.turnstile-site-key: The site key of the Turnstile widget you made in Cloudflare, for the bot check on signing in by email. It is public. Its secret key goes under Keys, at the foot of this page.
core.settings.sessions.lifetime.label: Stay signed in for at most
core.settings.sessions.lifetime.help: The longest a browser stays signed in before the person must sign in again.
core.settings.sessions.idle-limit.label: Sign out after being unused for
core.settings.sessions.idle-limit.help: A browser that has not been used for this long is signed out.
core.settings.recovery.code-count.label: Recovery codes in a set
core.settings.recovery.code-count.help: How many single-use recovery codes a person is given with their first passkey.
core.settings.grants.default-expiry.help: What a new role's end date starts as. Year end suits a committee that changes every year.
core.settings.grants.default-expiry.opti: At the end of the committee year
core.settings.grants.allow-no-expiry.lab: Roles may be given with no end date
core.settings.grants.allow-no-expiry.hel: When this is off, every role given must have an end date, except Owner.
core.settings.grants.expiry-warning.help: How far ahead the holder, and whoever can renew the role, are told that it is about to end.
core.settings.members-area.enabled.label: Members' area
core.settings.members-area.enabled.help: Whether the members' area exists at all. When it is off nobody sees a link to it.
core.settings.members-area.name.label: What you call the members' area
core.settings.members-area.name.help: Shown in the header and on screens, such as “Company area” or “Volunteers”.
core.settings.access-scheme.enabled.help: Whether people can apply to the theatre's access scheme from their account and the access page.
core.settings.access-scheme.name.label: Name of the scheme
core.settings.access-scheme.name.help: What the theatre calls its access scheme.
core.settings.access-scheme.allow-note.l: Take a note beside each need
core.settings.access-scheme.allow-note.h: Whether a person may add a short note beside each need they tick.
core.settings.access-scheme.companions-n: When on, free companion tickets are offered only once a reviewer has seen evidence in person.
core.settings.access-scheme.reply-within: How long an application may wait before it is flagged to the reviewers.
core.settings.access-scheme.review-after: Ask people to confirm their details after
How long after acceptance a person is asked to confirm their details are still right.
core.settings.access-scheme.keep-rejecte: How long a rejected application is kept before it is deleted.
core.settings.merge.undo-window.label: A merge can be undone for
core.settings.merge.undo-window.help: How long after two accounts are merged the merge can still be undone.
core.settings.privacy.cooling-off.label: Erasure waits for
core.settings.privacy.cooling-off.help: The wait between somebody confirming an erasure and it running. They can cancel during it.
core.settings.privacy.respond-within.hel: The date by which a data request should be answered. Set this to what your own law requires.
core.settings.privacy.export-lifetime.he: How long a person's download of their data is kept after it is made. It is removed after this.
core.settings.privacy.contact.label: Privacy contact
core.settings.privacy.contact.help: Who to contact about personal data. Erasure is not offered until this is set.
core.settings.rules.idle-within-lifetime: The unused time limit cannot be longer than the longest time a browser stays signed in.
core.settings.rules.managed-domains-need: Addresses can be made to use Google only while Google sign-in is on.
core.settings.rules.strong-provider-need: Google sign-in can count as strong only for addresses that must use Google. Add a domain first.
core.settings.rules.default-expiry-needs: New roles can start ending at the year end only once the theatre's year end is set on the organisation page.
core.settings.rules.google-needs-client-: Google sign-in needs the Google client id. Add it first.
Google sign-in needs the Google client secret. Save it under Keys, at the foot of this page, first.
core.settings.rules.domains-are-domains: Each entry must be a domain, such as newtheatre.org.uk, with no @ and no spaces.

core.settings-page.title: {module} settings
core.settings-page.advanced-warning: The defaults suit almost every theatre. Changing a limit here can slow the site, stop email going out or lock people out, so change one only when you know why.
core.settings-page.changed-only: Show only settings I have changed
core.settings-page.nothing-changed: Nothing on this page differs from its default
core.settings-page.reset-section-named: Reset section {section}: every changed setting goes back to its default

core.settings-history.description: Every change to a setting, newest first. Revert puts a setting back to what it was before that change.
core.settings-history.sensitive: This setting's values are never shown.
core.settings-history.revert-named: Revert {setting}, changed {when}, to what it was before
core.settings-history.unavailable: The history could not be loaded.
core.settings-history.drawer-description: Who changed this setting, when, and what it was before.

core.settings-page.managed: The system keeps this up to date, so it cannot be changed here.
core.settings-page.hidden: Hidden. Type a new value to replace it.
core.settings-page.confirm-set: {setting} is not set yet. It will be {to}.
core.settings-page.rate-hint: A period from 1 minute to 1 day

core.erasure.last-owner.person: You are the only person who can run the theatre's system. Someone else needs to be made an Owner before your account can be erased.

core.settings.appearance.default.label: Starting colour mode
core.settings.appearance.default.help: The colour mode a first-time visitor sees. People who choose their own keep their choice.
core.settings.appearance.let-people-choo: Let people choose light or dark
Off removes the appearance choice from the menu, so everyone sees the starting mode.
core.settings.appearance.public-dark.lab: Allow dark mode on the public pages
core.settings.appearance.public-dark.hel: Off keeps the public pages light, for a theatre whose posters assume it.
core.settings.appearance.live-dark.label: Dark screens in live mode
core.settings.appearance.live-dark.help: Live mode screens are dark in a dark auditorium. Off keeps them light.

core.admin.home.empty.description: Updates, failed jobs and anything that stops the site working show up here.
core.live.title: Tonight
core.live.offline-description: What is on screen stays readable, but changes cannot be sent until the connection returns.
core.live.empty.title: Nothing to open tonight
core.live.empty.description: Screens for working a performance appear here when you are on shift or hold a role that uses them.
core.credentials.saved-for-module: Using the value saved for the whole site
core.credentials.worker-secret: Using the Worker secret set in Cloudflare
core.credentials.replace: Leave blank to keep it, or type a new value
core.credentials.title: Keys
core.credentials.description: Kept encrypted and never shown again once saved. A key set as a Worker secret in Cloudflare is used until one is saved here.
core.credentials.remove-body: Anything that uses it stops working, unless a Worker secret of the same name is set in Cloudflare.
core.credentials.turnstile-secret-key.he: The secret key of the Turnstile widget whose site key is above. Signing in by email stays off until it is saved.
core.credentials.google-client-secret.he: The client secret from the same OAuth client as the Google client id above, in your Google Cloud project.
core.credentials.cloudflare-token.label: Cloudflare API token
core.credentials.cloudflare-token.help: A token with Email Sending edit and Zone read for the site's zone, made under My Profile > API Tokens in Cloudflare. With it, the sending domain can be set up automatically.
core.scan.title: Scan a code
core.scan.description: Hold the code up to the camera, inside the frame.
core.scan.problem.insecure: The camera can only be used on a secure (https) address.
core.scan.problem.no-camera: No camera was found on this device.
core.scan.problem.denied: The camera is not allowed for this site. Allow it in the browser's settings to scan.
core.scan.problem.failed: The camera could not be started.
core.scan.problem.type-instead: You can still type the code instead.
core.scan.problem.type-below: You can still type the code below.
core.abilities.webhook.manage.label: Look after webhooks: add, change, pause and resume them, rotate a secret, send a test and read the delivery log
core.settings.webhooks.max-attempts.help: How many times a delivery is tried before it fails for good. Each try waits four times as long as the last, from one minute.
core.settings.webhooks.pause-after.label: Failures before a webhook is paused
core.settings.webhooks.pause-after.help: After this many failed tries in a row, the webhook is paused, its managers are told, and nothing more is sent until someone resumes it.
core.settings.webhooks.log-retention.lab: Keep the webhook delivery log for
core.settings.webhooks.log-retention.hel: How long each webhook delivery stays in the log. Shortening it removes older entries at the next clean-up.
core.settings.webhooks.timeout.label: Wait for a webhook to answer
core.settings.webhooks.timeout.help: How long to wait for the receiving address to answer before the try counts as failed.
